notes: Straight scan of a base table with no join and no outer nesting, so every output column inherits its catalog nullability verbatim. `id` is the BIGSERIAL primary key, `created_at` and `text` are declared NOT NULL, and `owner_id` is the one column with no NOT NULL constraint. This is the baseline: an engine that gets this wrong has a catalog-lookup bug, not an inference bug.
